product.title: VIP Private Road to Hana Tour with Pick Up

description.text: See the best of Maui on this customizable, private Road to Hana adventure, where the day unfolds at your pace. Stop at stunning spots like Pua'a Ka'a, Wai'anapanapa State Park, Ke‘anae Point, Upper Waikani Falls, and Koki Beach, with time to explore volcanic beaches, waterfalls, and dramatic coastal views. Stops include Paia, Road to Hana, Ke'anae Peninsula, Wai'anapanapa State Park, Hana. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Maui's volcanoes, waterfalls, reefs, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
